subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should the remaining Google Chat Space @mention/session-creation work stay canonical here, or be consolidated into broader Google Chat Space/thread routing work?
rationale: The classifier fix is already merged, but current evidence points to a remaining mention-gate/session path whose durable fix could be diagnostics, mention parsing, setup validation, or consolidation with adjacent routing work; automation should not pick that product boundary alone.

options.title: Keep This As Canonical
options.body: Use this issue for the remaining mentioned-Space ingress bug and require a live Google Chat proof before closing it.

options.title: Consolidate With Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining requirement to the broader Google Chat Space/thread routing work and close this only after the canonical issue clearly preserves the @mention session-creation acceptance criteria.

options.title: Narrow To Diagnostics
options.body: Treat current runtime behavior as acceptable with `requireMention:false` as a workaround, and limit follow-up to setup/doctor/logging improvements for `botUser` and mention detection.

recommendation.title: Keep This As Canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the remaining mentioned-Space ingress bug and require a live Google Chat proof before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available routing owner from recent shared mention-policy work and current Google Chat access-path history.
